svg.title: Genus 16 sphere–torus gluing schematic
svg.desc: One connected closed surface with handles along the two former intersection circles. Its mesh genus is checked. This is an illustrative level-set smoothing, not a computed self-shrinker.

g.text: Illustrative desingularization, not a computed self-shrinker
Handles replace the two intersection circles. Rotate online to inspect them.
